note: Dated official notices, entered by hand from the official page on the date shown. A notice wins over an older dataset status. Recheck before any public release. Remove or update a notice when the official page changes.

notices.label: Temporarily closed (low water)
notices.text: N.C. State Parks reports the Vista Point boat ramp closed due to low water levels. Its published schedule also lists the Vista Point boat ramp season as March 2 to Nov. 30, 2026. Ebenezer Church and New Hope are listed as open alternatives.
notices.source_name: N.C. State Parks, Jordan Lake State Recreation Area

notices.label: Temporarily closed (low water)
notices.text: N.C. State Parks reports the Parkers Creek boat ramp closed due to low water levels.
notices.source_name: N.C. State Parks, Jordan Lake State Recreation Area

notices.label: Partly open: 1 ramp, single-axle trailers only
notices.text: N.C. State Parks reports Seaforth has 1 ramp open for single-axle trailers due to low water levels. The current published schedule lists the Seaforth day-use area as open year-round; it shows no Nov. 30 seasonal close for Seaforth.
notices.source_name: N.C. State Parks, Jordan Lake State Recreation Area

notices.label: Temporarily closed (construction)
notices.text: N.C. State Parks reports Holly Point is currently closed for construction. All other Falls Lake areas are listed as open as normal.
notices.source_name: N.C. State Parks, Falls Lake State Recreation Area

notices.text: N.C. State Parks reports most boat ramps at Kerr Lake closed due to low water levels. It lists its Kimball Point ramp and the NC Wildlife ramp at Hibernia as the only boat ramps open on the North Carolina side.
notices.source_name: N.C. State Parks, Kerr Lake State Recreation Area

notices.label: Status unclear: official sources disagree
notices.text: NCWRC data (last edited Nov 6, 2026) lists Hibernia as temporarily closed due to low water. The N.C. State Parks Kerr Lake banner checked Nov 27, 2026 lists the NC Wildlife ramp at Hibernia as open, and the same banner says the Hibernia area is closed for the season for construction. Check with the park before traveling.
notices.source_name: N.C. State Parks, Kerr Lake State Recreation Area
